subject: physics
content:
Match the temperature of a black body given in List-I with an appropriate statement in List-II, and choose the correct option.

[Given: Wien's constant as and ]

List - I List - II
(P) (1) The radiation at peak wavelength can lead to emission of photoelectrons from a metal of work function .
(Q) (2) The radiation at peak wavelength is visible to human eye.
(R) (3) The radiation at peak emission wavelength will result in the widest central maximum of a single slit diffraction.
(S) (4) The power emitted per unit area is of that emitted by a blackbody at temperature .
(5) The radiation at peak emission wavelength can be used to image human bones.
